description: Copy a file or folder on Proton Drive; the original stays. destinationPath is the target PARENT folder (unlike drive_move, which takes a full new path). Pass newName to copy under a different name — required to duplicate an item inside its own folder.

destinationPath.description: Absolute remote target PARENT folder, e.g. /my-files/Archive.

newName.description: Optional name for the copy (CLI --name). Required to copy an item into its own folder.

name: drive_copy
title: Copy item
